prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a hit while turning left. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1086; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The damage is mostly in line with the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours are a little high for this damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: The vehicle shows damage to the left front quarter panel, front bumper cover, and headlamp assembly, which fits the reported impact while turning left. The rear-side area shows minor scuffing that matches the same event. Nothing on the car points to older damage, and no earlier repair history has come to light. The shop's invoices list no repeated charges for the same parts or labor. The labor hours look a little high for this scope of work, so I recommend a line-by-line review before approval. Repair plan: replace the bumper cover and headlamp, repair and refinish the quarter panel, and recheck alignment after reassembly.
